evidence.summary: Every supplied criterion has a coverage entry, grounded in the provided design text.

coverage.evidence: The supplied design explicitly states that the parent "checks returned evidence against the original criteria, and retains responsibility for final completion." This directly supports that the parent remains accountable for final completion. The design also notes that the child works in its own workspace and receives bounded child work, reinforcing that the child is delegated scoped work rather than final ownership.

findings.observation: The design clearly assigns final completion responsibility to the parent while limiting the child to bounded work in its own workspace.
findings.recommendation: No change required for this criterion. If the design is expanded later, preserve this explicit parent accountability language and define any parent-side failure handling or escalation paths.
